notes.title: v1.1.2 - The Fast & Fancy Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed Errors From SharpPlusNative/GraphicsEngine Changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "--list-minigames" Flag To List Available Idle Minigames.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed All Left Over "Ownership" Code.[/p][/*][*][p]Added New Flexible Path Permissions Check, Making System Folder Private To The Admin User, User Home Folders Private To Each User.[/p][/*][*][p]The Editor Now Saves New Files As "/Users/\[UserName]/Test.txt" Rather Than "/MabelDOS/Test.txt".[/p][/*][*][p]The "admin" User's Home Folder Is The System Folder "/MabelDOS".[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed "HackerModeBGM" To "HackerMode".[/p][/*][*][p]Added CRT Screen Filter Effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Added The "toggle-crt" To Toggle The CRT Screen Filter Effect (Disabled By Default For Accessibility).[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced "minreq" With "reqwest", Making The "download" Command Faster, And Shrinking The Linux Build Back Down To The 900KB Range.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced LZMA Compression Of Assets With LZMA2, Speeding Decompression Up At The Cost Of A Tiny Size Increase.[/p][/*][*][p]"Edit" Command Now Requires A Filename As A Paramater.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Edit" Command To Help Blurb.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Timeout For Konamicon Achievement From 3 To 1 Seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Now Requires At Least 11 Accounts For The 10 User Accounts Achievement (Including The Admin Account).[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified The Achievements Code, Storing The Steam API Values As The Accessors Instead Of Arbitrary Index Values.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.1.1 - Clean & Tidy Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added Hash Verification For The AssetPack.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated To Revamped Graphics Engine, Which Also Has A More Efficient Keyboard Buffering System.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "idle --manual-click" Sub-Command Flag, To Manually Collect Idle Points.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "IdleDouble" Achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented Dependency Improvements Downstreamed From SharpPlusNative.[/p][/*][*][p]AssetPack Now Holds All Language Sheets, Removing The Need For Language Depos.[/p][/*][*][p]Default Language Sheet ("english") Now Embedded Into The Binary As A Fallback When Loading The Asset Pack Fails.[/p][/*][*][p]Default Language Sheet Not Included In AssetPack To Reduce File Size (It Loads The Embedded Version).[/p][/*][*][p]Added Intel MacOS Support, As It's Been Fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]If The Virtual Disk Image Can't Be Loaded, It Is Assumed It's Corrupted, Renamed Into A Backup, And Replaced By THe Default Disk State.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Crash When Static Base Files Cannot Be Unpacked.[/p][/*][*][p]Made "No Way Home" Advancement Possible.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed File Ownership.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed "chown" Command.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced UserName To Enter To Directly Reset From "reset" To "\[\[Reset]]". This Allows The "reset" User To Work Properly, And Makes The Reset Shortcut Less Likely To Cause Naming Collisions.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.1.0 - The Permissions Update!
notes.content: [list][*][p]Directories Store Files & Directories Under A Unified Store, So Now A File And A Directory Cannot Share A File Name.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated MabelMedia-LLC.SharpPlusNative To Use The Standard Library Rather Than The "byteorder" Crate For Binary Serialization, And Added A Standardized Format For booleans.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced Hard-Coded Permission Checks With User Ownership Markers.[/p][/*][*][p]Deduplicated Ownership Checks.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Chown" Command, To Change The Owner Of A File / Directory.[/p][/*][*][p]Files Under /MabelDOS And /home/admin Are Owned By The "admin" Account.[/p][/*][*][p]Added List Of Static / System Directories To Create When Extracting Static Resource Files To The Virtual Disk Image, Instead Of Hardcoding Said List.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.9 - Bug Fix Bonanza!
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added "Base64" Command To Encode / Decode Files With Base64 Encoding.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Automatic Wrapping Of Output Text, So The Help Lines Being To Long No Longer Matters. (Will Probably Still Break Them Up For Consistency's Sake)[/p][/*][*][p]The "Color" Command Errors When The Background And Foreground Colors Are The Same, So The Text Doesn't Become Invisible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Bug Where Failing To Meet The Password Requirements In The Initial Setup Program Will Replace The Username With The Failing Password.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Hiding Passwords In Prompts To Improve Accessibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking The Close Button On The Window Now Saves And Quits Immediately.[/p][/*][*][p]Entering "reset" At The Login Prompt Will Allow For Resetting The Save Without Needing The User Account Password.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Social Computing" Achievement No Longer Requires Exactly 10 User Accounts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Definition Of Insanity" And "Desperate For Help" Achievements (The Code For Them Was Removed By Accident).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hang On The "UserAdd" Command When New User Password Doesn't Meet The Complexity Requirements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Su" Command's Password Validation Failing To Verify.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.8 - The Colorful Update!
notes.content: [list][*][p]Scripts Now Split Lines On The ';' Character.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Reset" Command Now Resets Your Cloud Save (If Cloud Saving Is Enabled).[/p][/*][*][p]Added Better Console Coloring, Where The User Input Is Light Gray.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Sha256sum" Command To Hash Files.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Color" Command For Switching The Shell's Foreground & Background Color. It Accepts Color Indecies / Names ("light_gray", "white" Etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Errors Are Now Red, And Warning Messages Are Now Yellow.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "%HOSTNAME%", "%USERNAME%", "%CD%" And "%OS_VERSION%" Environment Variables.[/p][/*][*][p]You Can Now Customize The Prompt String With The "%PS1%" Environemnt Variable. Use The "Unset" Command To Reset It To Default.[/p][/*][*][p]Enviroment Variables Are Reset On Reboot.[/p][/*][*][p]"%HOSTNAME%" Loads From Virtual Disk On Startup.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Host Naming Step To Initial Setup.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.7 - Better Achievements & Safety
notes.content: [list][*][p]Moved Steam Achievement Save Failure String To The Language Sheet.[/p][/*][*][p]If The Steam Achievement Failed To Save, Don't Ask For All The Achievements To Be Updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Anti-Tamper Check To Prevent (Easy Use Of) DLL-SideLoading / SteamSDK Emulators, And To Not Load A Corrupted / Wrong Version SDK Library.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.6 - Performance, Error Handling And Accesibility Overhaul
notes.content: [list][*][p]Recursive Scripts No Longer Crash The Game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Download" Command To Download Files From The Internet Onto The Virtual Disk Image.[/p][/*][*][p]Writing A Save File Over The 1GB Cloud Quota Now Warns That It Won't Cloud Sync.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Error[/b] Handling To Advancements.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Error[/b] Handling To Saving In The Editor.[/p][/*][*][p]Saving In The Editor / Saving Advancements No Longer Saves The Virtual Disk Image.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed The "Konamicon" Advancement So It Now Resets On Wrong Key Press, And Requires All 9 Key Presses.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed 60 FPS Cap, IdleTSR Now Relies On System Time To Find Seconds. (Slightly Less Accurate, Much Better Performance).[/p][/*][*][p]Editor Cursor No Longer Blinks, To Improve Accesibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Editor Can Only Save Once Per 5 Seconds, Up From Once Per 1 Second.[/p][/*][*][p]Konamicon Advancement Now Resets If More Than 3 Seconds Are Taken Between Each Key Press.[/p][/*][*][p]F3 Is Now The Universal Keyboard Shortcut To Toggle A Debug FPS Counter In The Bottom Left Corner.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced 3 Second Startup Hang With 3 Second Delay That Real Data Loading Can Take Place In.[/p][/*][*][p]The Auto-Saving interval Timer Is Not Integrated Into The Main Timing System.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Disk Can't Be Read Error" Now Allows Exiting The Game By Clicking The Close Window Button.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebooting Fully Resets The Internal Game State, After Triggering A Manual Auto-Save.[/p][/*][*][p]Re-Added Extracting Static Files To First Time Setup, Regardless Of If An Update Just Happened.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Static" Command To Manually Extract Static Files From The Asset Pack, Onto The Virtual Disk Image. (Like These Changelogs!)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.5 - Safe & Smart Assets
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed "Pack", "Unpack" Commands Not Performing Proper Path Sanitization Checks.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Forked The MabelRPG AssetManager & AssetPacker Projects, To Remove The Unneeded MabelRPG Asset Types. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated Steam SDK To Latest.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.4 - Better Language Support
notes.content: [list][*][p]Moved Language Files Into Their Own Depot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AssetPacker Not Correctly Serializing Raw Buffer Lengths.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved Changelogs To AssetPack.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.3 - House Keeping!
notes.content: [list][*][p]Removed "Floppy" Command That Would Read A Bonus Physical Floppy Disk As DLC For A Shelved "Physical 1K Sales Promo".[/p][/*][*][p]Moved Default/Fallback Language Sheet And Changelog Asset Files Into AssetPack, Shrinking Binaries And Making Them Platform Independant.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Help Blurb Lines For "Pack" And "Unpack" Not Wrapping.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Better Language & Error Support
notes.content: Added Error Handling And Help Blurbs For "Pack" And "Unpack" Commands.
